Chapter 148 Knocking The Key To Liaodong

With the addition of Dian Wei, there were nearly a hundred bodyguards left, but he lost fifty or sixty people at once, and it was even impossible for the remaining people to surround the two of them, because the scope of the battle between the two was too wide , These people are crowded and can't be surrounded.

As for the dozen or so guards, there were still seven or eight of them left, all wounded, hiding in the distance and waiting for an opportunity to sneak attack, but it seemed that their death was also a matter of a while.

In the entire hall, there was silence, and no one could speak.

Everyone thought that he was looking for death, but they didn't expect that such a raptor crossing the river would directly overturn Mr. Yanchun's puddle of water.

‘Who is this person in front of me? There are so many first-class masters as subordinates, and it seems that these masters are very respectful to the people in front of them, and treat themselves as slaves, who on earth has such a pomp? ’ Gao Jianli asked himself in his heart, and after thinking about it, it seems that except for the state of Qin in the east, the king of Qin who tried to unify the world, no one else has this kind of treatment and strength.

After thinking about it, I still couldn't think of any clues, so I turned my gaze to Xue Nu in the center of the stage, wanting to see what kind of state he is now, this person I have admired for a long time.

‘Who, is this fighting for yourself? Men really are jealous...' Xue Nu thought in her heart, her thoughts were extremely deep.

The battle gradually came to an end, and the soldiers in front of Mr. Yanchun were gradually cleaned up. As the last soldier standing fell down, it meant that Mr. Yanchun no longer had the slightest guard, like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered, letting the mermaid go .

"No, no, don't come here, don't come here, don't kill me, let me go, I am Lord Yanchun, the most powerful man in Yan Kingdom except King Yan, as long as you let me go, what do you want? ? I can give it all to you!" Looking in horror at Zhang Fei and Zhang Fei who kept approaching him, a panicked voice came from Yanchun Jun.

"Hey, come here, your power and status in the country of Yan, how can you give us what we want, you should obediently follow me to the lord, kneel down and beg!" Zhang Fei was extremely fond of the person in front of him Disdain, how can he listen to his persuasion? For the king behind him, although he didn't show it on the surface, the generals like Zhang Fei were deeply afraid in their hearts.

He walked quickly to Jun Yanchun, raised his hands, grabbed his collar and lifted him out, then threw him back, carried him on his body, and walked towards Zhong Yu.

Jueying, who was fighting with Xu Chu and Zhao Yun next to him, heard his master Yanchun Jun's screams, his mind was in a trance, and he looked in the direction of Yanchun Jun.

But he was horrified to find that his master had already been captured by others, his movements inevitably stopped for a while, his mind also missed, and he no longer had the will to fight.

Zhao Yun and Xu Chu, who were beside them, saw this opportunity, but they had no intention of being soft-hearted.

They had long understood the dangers of the battlefield, but quickly shot, seized this slight flaw, and in two or three hits, severely injured Jue Ying, fell to the ground, dying, and kept vomiting blood.

At this point the battle came to an end, Lord Yanchun was captured, and his general Jueying was also seriously injured, so he was powerless to fight.

It can be said that in this battle that stunned everyone's attention, the performance of the four generals who finally swung down far exceeded everyone's imagination.

"Kneel down!" Coming in front of Zhong Yu, Zhang Fei threw his hands, and threw Yanchun Jun who was carrying him on the ground hard, causing him to cry out in pain.

"You wanted to kill me just now, how about it? Who is killing whom now?" Zhong Yu was full of teasing, his eyes were cold and he looked at Yanchun Jun, who was shivering on the ground like a dog, tired and trembling.

"My lord, it's a villain. I can't see Taishan with my eyes. I ran into my lord. I hope my lord will let me go like a dog. Please spare my life!" The geese who was frightened by this action Chun Jun, when he heard the question from the man in front of him, he cried out in pain.

"Oh, really? It's not impossible to let you go, but what can you give me?" Hearing Yanchun Jun's begging for mercy, Zhong Yu was noncommittal.

"My lord, what do you want? Go ahead and say, as long as I have, I can give it to your lord. Wealth and wealth, high officials and nobility!" Yan Chunjun quickly said what he could give.

"What you said, I don't want anything, I only want one thing, your decree. And him, the tiger talisman general order used to mobilize the army!" Zhong Yu said his goal, and pointed his right hand, looking at General Yan Yi's direction.

"This..." Hearing the request of the man in front of him, Jun Yanchun hesitated for a while, and the crying stopped.

His decree and the tiger talisman to mobilize the army are not ordinary things. If he really handed it over, even if he can survive now, he will be killed by his nephew, the king of Yan.

Yan Yi, the general in the distance, even changed his face after hearing this sentence, his legs slowly fell back, and he looked around, as if he wanted to escape.

"So, you don't want to, or do you think this decree and the tiger talisman are more important than your life? Also, General Yan, do you, the guest, want to leave before the master speaks?" asked in a cold voice , Zhong Yu turned his head to look in Yan Yi's direction.

"No, it's nothing, how dare I run away? My lord, you've learned a lot!" After realizing that his actions had been spotted, Yan Yi was frightened and said with embarrassment.

"Then come here and tell me whether you want to or not!" Zhong Yu snorted coldly and ordered Yan Yi to come over.

Yan Yi came to Zhong Yu with a face full of apprehension and reluctance. Standing in front of him, I felt goosebumps all over my body and felt uncomfortable.

"General Yan, tell me, is Yan willing to give it, or not?" Zhong Yu asked lightly, and several guards behind him also pulled out their swords in response.

Looking at the situation in front of him that seemed to be about to die on the spot if he didn't agree with each other, Yan Yi said sensiblely, "Don't be angry, my lord, I will give it to you, I will give it to you." As he spoke, he touched his arms and took out a token.

"What about Lord Yanchun? How do you think about it!" Zhong Yu turned to look at Lord Yanchun.

"My lord, I will also give it to the villain, and I will also give it to the villain!" Jun Yanchun saw the man in front of him and looked at himself, and said in a panic, and quickly took out his token from his arms.

"In this case, you each sign an order, bring your own order, and then you can leave!" Zhong Yu took out the order he had just drafted and asked the two to copy it again.

Yan Chunjun and Yan Yi looked at each other, finally sighed, picked up the pen and paper handed over to them silently, and began to write.
